account-sign-in-description: Use the passkey or wallet you created your account with.
account-create-description: An account keeps your progress on any device and lets ethereum.org confirm what you finish. No email or password: use a passkey or a wallet.
account-wallet-statement: Sign in to ethereum.org. This signature costs nothing and can't move funds.
account-wallet-taken: This wallet is already used by another account.
account-leaderboard-hint: You can change this any time on your profile.
account-error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
account-methods-hint: Add a second passkey or a wallet as a backup, so losing a device doesn't lose your account.
account-delete-description: Your account and the progress saved to it are deleted for good. Progress saved in this browser stays.
account-leaderboard-hint-profile: Leaderboards are in development. Coming soon.
account-leaderboard-opt-out: Turn this off to stay off public leaderboards.
account-leaderboard-opt-in: Turn this on to appear on public leaderboards.
account-name-characters: Use letters, numbers, spaces and . _ ' - only.
account-name-link: A name can't look like a link or an email address.
account-name-reserved: That name could pass for ethereum.org or its team. Try another.
account-name-language: That name includes a word we don't allow. Try another.
